# Jubilees Chapter 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** The Sabbath laws — the most stringent Sabbath legislation in ancient Judaism; the book's close

---

**50:1** And after this law I made known to thee the Sabbaths of the land, and the Sabbath years, and the jubilees, from the days of Adam. And the LORD commanded thee to keep the Sabbath on the day of thy rest.

**50:2** And every man who doeth any work thereon, or who goeth on a journey, or who doeth commerce, or who draweth water that had not been prepared on the day before, or who lifteth up any burden to carry it out of his dwelling or out of his house — such a man shall die.

**50:3** And ye shall do no work on the day of the Sabbath, whatever it be, save that which ye have prepared for yourselves on the sixth day to eat and drink and rest and keep Sabbath from all work on that day, and to bless the LORD your God, who has given you this day of festivity and holy day and day of the holy kingdom for all Israel.

**50:4** This day is greater among all the days. On this day ye shall be holy; ye shall rest from all work.

**50:5** And whoever profanes this day, whoever doeth any work thereon, shall die. And whoever profanes it shall die.

**50:6** Ye shall not kindle fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day. Ye shall make no food on the Sabbath. Ye shall prepare all food on the sixth day before the Sabbath.

**50:7** Ye shall not carry anything outside or inside the house on the Sabbath.

**50:8** And ye shall not lift up and carry from house to house on the Sabbath.

**50:9** And ye shall do nothing on the Sabbath day save bless the LORD your God.

**50:10** And whoever beareth a burden to carry it out of his dwelling on the Sabbath day, he shall die.

**50:11** And whoever journeyeth on the Sabbath day, to go upon business or upon a way — not the way of returning home — such a man shall die.

**50:12** Whoever draweth a sword or bow on the Sabbath, or draws any implement of war — he shall die.

**50:13** And whoever catcheth an animal or a bird or a fish on the Sabbath, he shall die.

**50:14** Whoever does any work on the Sabbath, or goes on a journey, or tills his field, or plows it, or cuts anything, or lights a fire, or loads a beast, or sails a ship, or strikes or kills anything, or slaughters a beast or a bird, or catches a fish, or fasts, or wages war on the Sabbath —

**50:15** The man who does any of these things on the Sabbath shall die, so that the children of Israel shall observe the Sabbath according to the commandments of the Sabbaths of the land, as it is written in the tablets which he gave into my hands that I should write for thee the law of every time.

**50:16** And here is the completion of the account of the division of the days. From the day of creation to the day on which the new creation is made, when the heavens and the earth and all their creatures shall be renewed like the powers of the sky and like all the creatures of the earth, until the day when the sanctuary of the LORD shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion — all the years and all the days shall be hallowed and consecrated from that time until this.

**50:17** And lo, the whole account of the division of the days of the law and of the testimony has now been completed. And thou didst give it to Moses on Mount Sinai, until the new creation is made, when the sanctuary of the LORD shall be built in Jerusalem for all eternity.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 50 is the final chapter of Jubilees and contains the most stringent Sabbath legislation in any ancient Jewish text. The death penalty is prescribed for: working (v.2), carrying (vv.7-8, 10), traveling (v.11), wielding weapons (v.12), hunting (v.13), plowing, cutting, fire-lighting, loading animals, sailing, killing, slaughtering, fishing, fasting (v.14), and waging war (v.14). Notably, even FASTING is prohibited on the Sabbath — reflecting an anti-ascetic tradition. V.16-17 close the entire book of Jubilees with a vision of the new creation and the eschatological sanctuary.*
